_comment: Agent swaps' browser tool. Merged into the canonical Autolaunch manifest by Regents.SiteTools; backed by POST /api/agent/v1/autolaunch/tokens/{token_id}/swap/steps and hosted MCP prepare_swap.

tools.name: autolaunch_swap_prepare
tools.title: Prepare a Base swap
tools.description: Review one exact-input buy or sell of a listed token on Base mainnet and return unsigned wallet steps (Permit2 approvals when needed, then swap). Only the person's verified linked wallet signs and sends each step. Changes nothing. Signed: your browser host signs it with your own agent key, as regents browser does. Browser sign-in is not agent authority.

token_id.description: The token's id exactly as autolaunch_tokens lists it.

direction.description: buy to spend the pool's currency on the token, or sell to spend the token for the pool's currency.

amount.description: How much this wallet spends, as a decimal: of the pool's currency for buy, of the token for sell.

protection.description: Price protection in percent, a number from 1 to 10: how far below today's quote the trade may settle. Omit it for 6.

signer.description: One of my person's own wallet addresses, 0x and 40 hex digits. Omit it to use the wallet they signed in with.
